# dvls_administrative_role_assignment (Resource)

A DVLS administrative role assignment: grants one administrative role to one principal (user, user group or application) on one scope.

Requires DVLS 2026.3 or later. Every attribute forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dvls_vault" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Grant the built-in Vault User role on a vault
resource "dvls_administrative_role_assignment" "vault_user" {
  role_name   = "Vault User"
  assignee_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  scope_type  = "vault"
  scope_id    = dvls_vault.example.id
}

# Global assignment by role id
resource "dvls_administrative_role_assignment" "vaults_administrator" {
  role_id     = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004"
  assignee_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  scope_type  = "global"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignee_id` (String) The ID of the principal receiving the role (user, user group or application).
- `scope_type` (String) The scope type of the assignment. Possible values are [gateway, global, organizational_unit, pam_provider, vault].

### Optional

- `role_id` (String) The ID of the administrative role. Exactly one of `role_id` or `role_name` must be set.
- `role_name` (String) The name of the administrative role. Exactly one of `role_id` or `role_name` must be set.
- `scope_id` (String) The ID of the scoped resource (vault, gateway, PAM provider or organizational unit). Required unless `scope_type` is `global`, in which case it must be omitted.

### Read-Only

- `assignee_name` (String) The display name of the principal, as reported by DVLS.
- `assignee_type` (String) The type of the principal. Possible values are [application, user, user_group].
- `id` (String) The ID of the assignment. This is set by the provider after creation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# This resource can be imported using `<role_id>/<scope_type>/<scope_id>/<assignee_id>` format, e.g.
terraform import dvls_administrative_role_assignment.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000f/vault/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000

# Leave <scope_id> empty for a global assignment
terraform import dvls_administrative_role_assignment.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004/global//00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
